title: Send net_fdm Packet to FlightGear
text: Transmit net_fdm packet to destination IP address and port for FlightGear session, 1 input; {Destination IP address}, {Destination port} and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Destination IP address
params.values: Destination IP address for remote computer 127.0.0.1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Destination port
params.values: Destination port for remote computer 5502 (default) | scalar
